chunks.text: MPEDA HACCP & Export Compliance Manual for Frozen Shrimp Exports from Chennai & Tuticorin Ports. This document provides official regulatory, scientific, and field protocols tailored for aquaculture practitioners and researchers in Tamil Nadu.
Maintain dissolved oxygen above 4.0 mg/L, pH between 7.5 and 8.5, and zero free ammonia. Implement bird netting, crab fencing, and reservoir disinfection with 30 ppm active chlorine before stocking.
